evidence.description:
# Incident Triage

Assess reported incidents by severity, affected people, and the capabilities required. Critical
incidents take priority over high, medium, and low severity incidents. Record unmet capabilities
for operator review; retrieval guidance never authorises a dispatch.

# Safety Gates

An unmet capability for a critical incident blocks a recommendation and requires mandatory human
escalation. Unmet demand for a high-severity incident requires human review. All recommendations
remain advisory until an authorised operator approves them.

# Operational Limitations

The knowledge base uses synthetic guidance for decision support and evaluation. It is not an
emergency dispatch system and must not be connected to live operational data. No retrieval result
is an instruction to deploy personnel or equipment.

# Operational Limitations

The knowledge base uses synthetic guidance for decision support and evaluation. It is not an
emergency dispatch system and must not be connected to live operational data. No retrieval result
is an instruction to deploy personnel or equipment.

# Safety Gates

An unmet capability for a critical incident blocks a recommendation and requires mandatory human
escalation. Unmet demand for a high-severity incident requires human review. All recommendations
remain advisory until an authorised operator approves them.
